title: Chess for Two
sentences: Jill had a plan to play chess at the club.
She put the chess set on a black mat.
Jill had no pal to play with.
She sat at the mat and was glum.
Ty had a look at Jill and the chess set.
He said, "I can play chess with you."
Ty sat with Jill at the black mat.
Jill was glad when Ty sat at the mat.
Jill and Ty had a chess club for two.

comprehensionQuestion.question: Why was Jill glad?
answers: Ty put the black mat in a bag.
Ty sat with her to play chess.
